newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 17.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following business stories in its Dec. 17 edition:
WASHINGTON - Giant Food Inc. laid off hundreds of warehouse and production workers as a strike by Teamsters delivery drivers entered its second day with no talks scheduled.
WASHINGTON - Dart Group Corp. set off a fight for control of Shoppers Food Warehouse, the 34-store Washington area supermarket chain.

WASHINGTON - Investment bankers are joining admirals and generals as key defense industry players, assembling two big new deals, while investors are still absorbing the $13.3 billion acquisition of McDonnell Douglas Corp. by Boeing Co.

WASHINGTON - Twelve Reserve bank presidents and the seven members of the Federal Reserve Board will discuss the state of the U.S. economy and whether there is any need for a change in the level of short-term interest rates.

WASHINGTON - The proposal to merge the nation's two remaining commercial aircraft manufacturers could put the Clinton administration in the uncomfortable position of choosing between a stronger U.S. aerospace industry or lower air fares for consumers.
